# Saved camp fixtures

camp-31301.kds is an idle camp from delivery 31301 at 07:00.
camp-31302.kds is an actual delivery 31302 living camp at game second 26000, captured through the phone page in seed 17. Its CAMP 2 and LIFE 1 retain the original bodies, actions and memory; it has no DRMS extension. The migration test compares its body/action/memory/event bytes before and after adding dream state.
